content: Wenati Waitare

Hatyo hiyeta, nohinaeharenai, maika Enore airakoaneharetitere xiso hiyeta niraehena xikakoa: maika xiháre xisehena Enore ana, kinasetatere isoawitere akereta, ehatene xisoma maheta, exahe aokitere akereta xisaohena. Nikareya atyo xisaona hoka hatyoiya atyo aliterexe xisaonita ekoamaniya.

Hoka awa atyo matyakekoneharenai tyaonitere akereta xisaona, xakore hoka maika kotare Enore waiye maniya moheta xiyahekolanai. Nikare ite hoka waiyekehalaka xomana Enore aokitereharenai, xoare xamani waiyexe, ehekorexe, exahe awaiyetitereharenai.

Enore hawaiyexehare hiyeta iyateliti isehenere nomani hiyeta niraehena xikakoa: Awa atyo hatya xinekonitare hatahi taita ahekohena, exahe hoka haiyanae xahexe nawaiye aokowihena. Maika waiye ahekotya, Enore hatya ana xakini tyakekoti isehenere hiyeta.
Hiyaiya, wiháre kaxiyehare hoka hatya xakini atyo kahatenexe.
Nikare tehitiya wiso tyakekohenerenae. Wikahare xakore hoka Cristo hiyeta haterore wisaona. Hoka wityotya hahotyalita wisaonita haiyanae hawareharexe haríti kaomakere kakoa.
Waiyoliniti, Iyateliti Waiyexe Enore Isa Halitini Ana

Hatyo hiyeta nika wisomehena wihatene hawareharexe xakini, Enore isehenerehare womana hawaiyexehare hiyeta. Wihatene atyoite wiyakaini Enore niraene tahi hoka hatyoharenai atyoite wisomehena wityakekone hakakoaneta.
Wahaka mahetaiya hoka wahaka. Waotyakisa mahetaiya hoka waotyakisa.

Exahe waihalahalinikisa mahetaiya haiyanai hoka waihalahalinikisahene. Hatyaiya haxiyehare hiyeta isa aokowita haiyanae ana hoka maika haihalaharene kakoa isa. Xala xamaniya xekohaseti hoka hahatene kakoa irihare. Exahe xala tehitiya xamaniya haiyanae kahinaetya hoka haihalaharene kakoa kahinaetyahene.
Wenati Waiyexe
Maika xawaiyetya kaiserehare haiyanai. Xahalakihena iniyalahare hoka waiyexe xema taita xisaohena.
Maika xihinaeharenae xihalaharene kakoa xawaiyetya, Cristo xema tyaonahitere hiyeta. Exahe maika waiyexe taita xisomehena haiyanai kakoa, xaiminisakakoa maheta.
Maika kalore xahaka, awa atyo ximaxahare. Xihalaharene kakoaira xahaka Xekohaseti ana.
Heko xatyahahena Xekohaseti xahita xihalaharene kakoa, exahe xakore haiya xowaka xawenane howitihare tyaonita hoka heko ximamaxaharenehare xisaona hoka awa atyo xahalakihena xiraexala.
Haiyanae Enore koamaniya tyaoniterenae xoalini hare aokitereharenae kakoa xirakakakoahena xoare xamani xikaxiyehareta hoka. Exahe haiyanae kaokehena hoka waiye xamokahene xihanako.
Enore hiye xiraehena kirawanetereharenae xiso waiye moka maheta. Xaxehenene hoka waiye mokene hoka awa atyo iniyalahare exomokakaha xaoka.
Maika ihalahareterenae kakoa xihalahare, exahe tiyitereharenae kakoa hoka xitiya.
Haiyanae kakoa ximehexaiko xisaohena hahotyalita. Awa atyo xaokowiharetyoa, awa atyo ximaxawaiyera wakaharenae, awa atyo kalore xawaiyore xaokowi.
Awa atyo haiyanae iniyalahare mohena xiso hoka hatyo nahalakoa iniyalahare xamokene. Maika xisomehena tyotya halitinai waiyexe aokitereharenai.
Exahe xoana xamani xikaxomokakehena hoka maika xaiyateretyoa hoka ximehexaikohare xisaona haiyanai kakoa.
Nohinaeharenae, maika hatya iniyalahare moka aokowihena xiso hoka awa atyo xikatolikoa xaokowi. Maika Enore ana xahalakisene hoka katolikoaretya xiso. Exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa nexa:

content.text: “Natyo atyoite nakatolikoarehena xiso, exahe nabakahenahene”, nexa Xekohaseti.

content: Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa iraehenere akereta xisaona:

content.text: Maika hahalakoahare nakita hoka nakairati hisa enomana hoka kanakaira, oinita hoka one hisa enomana hoka tera. Nikareya hisaona hoka hahalakoahare hehaihalikisa, nexa.

content: Awa atyo iniyalahare xahalaisa hoka jiyahaotya xiso. Xaiyateretyoa hoka waiyexe kakoa iniyalahare xijiyahaotya.
